alasan: Blocked or closed off matches render unsuitable for passage.
Gloss 'form an edge or boundary along' is sense 2; fence along road reads same as encircle.
Loud deep sound of a vehicle matches loud noise as of vehicles.
Courage gloss is sense 2; 'did not dare' reads the same as the presumptuous sense here.
'Arrive at or get to' is sense 1; couldn't get at him reads same as touch.
Emphasizing that something is likely matches high-probability sense.
Really or genuinely matches in accordance with truth or reality.
Stop dealing with a topic is figurative leaving behind, matching gold.
Express an opinion is sense 1 (express in speech); sentence understood the same.
System of faith and worship fits organized religion (sense 2); same reading here.
Move or spread very quickly matches move very quickly.
Cause someone to be in a particular state matches bring into a different state.
Be aware of or have knowledge matches cognizant of a fact.
Make something warm or hot matches make hot or hotter.
Make seem small by comparison matches gold.
Consider carefully before deciding matches using the mind to make decisions.
Speaking or having a conversation matches exchange thoughts; talk with.
Require as essential matches have need of.
Appear or seem is sense 2 (outward aspect); same reading as facial expression.
Make oneself quiet and relaxed matches make calm.
Most suitable course of action is sense 2 (advisable); reading unchanged.
Particular or specific (tertentu) matches definite but not specified.
Judgment made after consideration is sense 2 (result, not act); same reading.
Trained or taught matches educate as if in a school.
Cause to do or result in fits sense 5, not leading a performance.
Worry, disturb, annoy is sense 2; 'did not bother her' reads the same.
Start dealing with a problem matches begin to deal with.
Seem to be a certain way matches give a certain impression.
Distinctive or particular is sense 1; 'particular attention' conveys the same emphasis.
Notice taken of something matches concentrating on some features.
Emphasizing something surprising matches intensive indicating the unexpected.
Discharge a gun matches start firing a weapon.
Requiring endurance, tiring (melelahkan) matches effort to the point of exhaustion.
Meet or visit is a social sense, not perceiving by sight.
Sensing or perceiving is a perception sense, not the emotional sensation in gold.
Cease matches putting an end to an activity.
Made by a tailor fits sense 3 (create clothes); reading unchanged.
Indicate or identify as is sense 2 (designate); same reading as distinctive trait.
Having an opinion or belief is sense 1, not exercising the mind.
Electronic device receiving radio waves matches receiver.
Switching off implies not in operation, matching gold.
Person or thing used instead matches takes the place of another.
Period of 12 months matches period of 365 days.
Start doing something energetic matches begin with vigor.
Direct your eyes matches direct one's gaze towards.
Feel curiosity matches desire to know something.
Put name on an official record matches record in a public office.
Communicate a feeling matches articulate, as in expressing anger.
Become aware through the ears matches perceive sound.
Begin doing something matches take the first step.
Striking someone (with a pistol) is the beating sense of whipping.
Important matches significant.
Additional information or updates matches information about recent events.
Supernatural or mystical experience matches gold.
Without making much noise matches with little or no sound.
Having no requirement is negated have need of.
Identical to gold: go away from a place.
Take place or occur matches come to pass.
Look for a long time matches look with fixed eyes.
At a time in the future matches eventual future time.
Become part of a group matches gold.
Discover a fact matches make a discovery.
Remain in an open state matches be in a specified state.
Have something inside matches have within.
Utilize for a specific purpose matches put into service.
Resting on a chair or surface matches be seated.
Experience a particular emotion matches undergo an emotional sensation.
Item written in a record is general sense 1; ledger transaction reading unchanged.
Having in mind something from the past matches recall from memory.
Be in a horizontal position matches be lying.
Unable to speak from strong emotion matches choking with emotion.
Move smoothly and quietly into position matches insert quietly or quickly.
Perceive something happening matches perceive or be contemporaneous with.
Assist someone matches give help or assistance.
Say you will not do or accept is sense 1, not elude or defy.
Composed, serious manner matches formality in bearing.
Higher degree than desirable matches exceeding proper limits.
Hinged barrier in a wall or fence matches movable barrier.
Single foot surface is sense 6; 'porch steps' reads the same as a flight.
Social gathering of guests matches group gathered for pleasure.
Land higher than surroundings matches elevation of the land.
Territory matches territory over which control is exercised.
Sudden surprise or emotional distress matches feeling of distress and disbelief.
Having an opinion or belief is sense 1, not recalling from memory.
Gloss explicitly includes importance, matching major significance.
Make clear or easy to understand matches make plain.
Be certain or sure matches regard as true beyond doubt.
Entrusting power into their hands is placing it in an abstract location.
Show consideration matches show respect towards.
Disappear suddenly and completely matches get lost without warning.
Outing on foot fits walking for pleasure, not accompany or escort.
Shrub matches low woody perennial plant.
Very good or admirable is sense 4, not major significance.
Going to the town refers to the urban area.
Speak in a low, barely audible voice matches gold.
Contact someone by telephone matches gold.
Be aware of a fact matches gold.
Demonstrate that something is true matches establish validity.
Propel through the air matches gold.
In addition; also matches gold.
